study_output: none; root owns cold-finding prioritization, independent review, strict rehearsal and later cohort
qualification: test-only source fixtures; unchanged, unchanged, independently pinned source edit
git_visibility: two fixed synthetic commits from selected source only; no upstream history
warmup: none; first task, initial installation/index, refusals and all failures count
cache: OS cache uncontrolled and recorded; alternate batch order; do not flush host caches
measurement: one batch wall admission-to-finalization; per-task spans overlap it and must not be added
denominator: all scheduled slots, including failed, refused and not_run
usage: retain per-field coverage and raw observations; no input+output total, price, cache-subset or multi-turn inference
live_run: separate explicit root approval and frozen cohort required; this protocol authorizes no provider calls
